The typical procedure for the synthesis of polymer ia is as follows: The monomer ia (400 mg, 0.67 mol) and AIBN (2 wt %) were dissolved in dry THF (5 mL) and gentle steam ofnitrogen purged into the solution. The solution was kept in an oil bath at $6 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$for 48 h. Then, the solution was cooled and poured into excess of methanol to precipitate the product. The crude polymer thus obtained was represipitated twice using chloroform and methanol. The purified polymer was dried at $4 5 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$under vacuum for 48 h to afford yellow colored solid. The remaining Ib–IIc was also prepared by adopting similar procedure as of Ia.
